programme.title: Inside Maximum Security
programme.desc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

programme.title: Origin of the Species
programme.desc: Abigail Child has been at the vanguard of experimental media since the 1980s In her latest project, she offers viewers an eerie look into the present and future of AI, through the perspectives of scientists, entrepreneurs and a Black lesbian robot Child’s thought-provoking film considers the emerging technology’s ethical and emotional implications, presenting a speculative, not-too-distant future grounded in sci-fi

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 王良牧牧師- 神蹟醫治
programme.desc: 曾經是中國腫瘤科外科醫生,現在是美國基督工人神學院教牧博士的王良牧牧師,詳細講解什麼是神蹟醫治。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:戰勝生命中的「只是」 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 程蒙恩長老-初信成長2
programme.desc: 在你接受耶穌那一刻,一個新生命已經在你裡面誕生。你瞭解這個新生命的身份和地位嗎?你希望過上嶄新的生活嗎?你渴望更認識上帝和聖經嗎?就讓程蒙恩長老和你一起走上這條信徒成長之路。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-婚姻的藍圖
programme.desc: 何偉強牧師從婚姻中遇到的不同課題,包括理財、溝通、姻親關係、性愛助你從《聖經》中瞭解處理方法,你經營一段美好的婚姻。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 王良牧牧師- 神蹟醫治
programme.desc: 曾經是中國腫瘤科外科醫生,現在是美國基督工人神學院教牧博士的王良牧牧師,詳細講解什麼是神蹟醫治。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室

方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#171粵
programme.desc: 舊同學阿融要邀請花出席舊生聚會。義卻看中花的舊同學群，應有不少富家子弟，正是他推銷保險的最佳時機，於是自薦成為花的舞伴。眾人大表贊成，眾女士更越俎代庖，為花準備舞會的「戰衣」，根本沒有理會花的感覺。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#16粵普
programme.desc: 郭靖和黃蓉利用竹排挪開巨石，歐陽鋒救出歐陽克。之後歐陽鋒以洪七公要脅郭靖默寫九陰真經，又要求他砍樹造船。黃蓉和郭靖帶著洪七公乘木筏離開，途中遇上風浪，三人看到前方有大船便呼救，怎料竟遇上完顏洪烈等人。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌 之 森田面膜咁敷至完美粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 六號拿起菜檔的紫芯淮山把玩，結果肥媽要炮製「紫淮山雞煲」來「執手尾」。食過海金友魚的朋友，可有想過用南瓜、花奶煮出「黃金海金友」？肥媽以生筋、豆卜炮製「油豆腐粉絲湯」，還教大家做「藍莓無芝士蛋糕」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 睡眠窒息症是一種常見睡眠障礙，患者睡覺時會因上呼吸道變窄，而導致反覆出現窒息或半窒息，增加罹患高血壓、糖尿病等疾病風險。家庭醫學專科醫生詳析睡眠窒息症的三大類別，並細說如何透過睡眠測試評估病情，並帶來治療資訊。遺囑與持久授權書是最常需要醫生評估並親自見證的法律文件，律師講解二者分別，以及訂立時的注意事項。腦神經外科醫生則述說為患者做評估的相關細節。「睇餸食飯」，許美德師傅示範「潮州蠔烙拼炸銀魚」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 斧頭扒深受肉食者喜愛，往深圳叫一個雙人餐，斧頭扒盡情撕吃兼副食放題！三人同行的話，加選鵝肝牛小排，CP值亦高。珠海某間在水中央的玻璃屋小店，日系風情配上充滿禪意的「藝術甜品」，秀怡還預約好幾款隱藏甜點，驚喜連連。香港有間百年老字號餐廳，在商場開設年輕版分店，菜式將傳統與新派融合，濃味之餘亦喚出兩代人的溫情與幸福感；再到另一個商場的日式食肆享用廚師發辦，海膽、豆腐、蟹膏同時放進嘴裡，口感有多豐富？

programme.title: 天梯#2粵
programme.desc: 美娟要新月接手當家之職，但她拒絕，美娟懷疑自己時日無多。廣達發現賀正堂大查櫃賀坤堯從中食價，最終無法把藥材賣出，苗天只好硬著頭皮求賀正堂，豈料二查櫃，即坤堯的兒子世豪肆意侮辱，鄭嬌忍無可忍出手打世豪。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 山田扮鬼臉逗得大家笑成一團，回家後更拿來火男面具助陣，小丸子家中沒面具，於是嘗試自行製作。小丸子嘗試把蜜瓜籽拿去種，小衫待種子發芽後討了部分蜜瓜苗回去種，並把小丸子視為親密好友。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 橋咀洲位於香港東面，屬於世界地質公園的一部份，島上因火山爆發而形成的「菠蘿包石」，歷史竟可追溯至一億年前！橋咀洲附近海域還孕育了豐富的海洋生態，更有大量珊瑚聚居。對於有意下水探索這神奇海洋世界的遊客，海洋保育專家提醒要注意的事項。不過，大批慕名而來的遊人，卻可能對島上與周邊水域的生態造成負擔。嘉賓所屬的環保團體，會向到訪橋咀洲的遊客宣揚保育訊息，另呼籲大家緊記「自己垃圾，自己帶走」。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 細菌人發現芝士狗正準備與奶酪狗約會，便出手妨礙，令奶酪狗迷路，更假扮奶酪狗芝士狗見面。細菌人在雪祭的場地搗亂時，被鰹魚節人擊退了。之後心有不甘的細菌人，以謊言煽動雪鬼攻擊鰹魚節人。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌 之 森田面膜咁敷至完美粵
programme.desc: 天水圍一個屋苑，最新一期入伙，露台圍欄輕微刮花，廳房均設有隔音屏，整體質素如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 2026香港小姐 敢．至完美粵
programme.desc: 有僱主與外傭終止合約後，陸續收到兩間財務公司的追債信，懷疑外傭趁政府新規例生效前借款並離職，試圖逃避債務。女網友經網上遊戲結識一名自稱泰拳冠軍的男子，並發展親密關係後意外懷孕，繼而在男方安排下墮胎。事後渣男母親卻指墮胎影響其子運程，多次情緒勒索女事主。女事主借錢幫男方還債後，竟發現男方屢次出軌……香港小姐候選佳麗會晤大會評判及最上鏡小姐評判，伍允龍、謝天華透露評分標準。另介紹有關管理強積金的資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#13粵
programme.desc: 范特栖口甜舌滑，在公司備受厚待，惹來文謙等人不滿。農曆七月十四當天，殯儀公司委託跨世代為其宣傳，萬里與楊帆爭相負責該項目。該公司負責人要求二人各自提交計劃書，再作決定。萬里與楊帆需外出處理事務，范特栖答應楊帆留守辦公室趕工，獨力完成計劃書；文謙等人為免被認為偷懶，遂不敢回家工作，只好留下加班。入夜後，文謙提起有關辦公室的恐怖傳聞，碧池發現范特栖似乎生性怕鬼，眾人遂設法嚇唬他。范特栖接連遭遇怪事……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#18粵
programme.desc: 雪文、繼威婚禮上，雪文安排由特約演員扮演「媽媽」，詎料……雪文認定是幸如暗裡策劃要破壞婚禮，遷怒於幸如……熙妍酒醉時情不自禁親吻浩恩，隨後驚覺自己對浩恩有意。熙妍怕自己會成為「小三」背叛幸如，迴避浩恩。幸如於覆診時遇見婉蘭，更得知婉蘭的不幸近況。曉彤想安排家謙加入泰國渡假村小組，以爭取更大權力，但被啟榮、哲朗連成一線打壓；曉彤遂使計反擊啟榮……

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#23粵普PG
programme.desc: 包子出師，許母擔心被取代，許父趕來酒店與紀封交涉，最終紀封同意支付20萬，但要求他們用這筆錢幫蜜語還債。芷純向蜜語坦言自己試圖與紀封復合但被拒絕，勸她不要錯過當下，蜜語深受感動，決定勇敢面對自己的感情。

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Slim益生菌呈獻：南美潮什麼2粵PG
programme.desc: 厄瓜多爾基多市被指是最接近赤道的首都，到遊客打卡位拍照兼食一支似雪糕但不凍的甜品，再花幾美元到赤道博物館，附導遊講解，抵玩！芷珮嘗試體驗一些跟赤道有關的科學現象，卻不太成功，還是將重點放在買手信吧。轉機前赴旅程尾站哥倫比亞，先往第二大城市麥德林，當地的13區曾是毒品之都，現已翻新為充滿藝術、音樂的景點。乘約一小時車，芷珮登上在高山的咖啡莊園，親手摘咖啡豆、品味最新鮮的咖啡，還可騎馬沿農場走一圈。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌 之 森田面膜咁敷至完美粵
再創世紀#31粵PG
programme.desc: 定垚漸得董事信任，啟堂擔心地位不保，暗中將她的鐵丸換成抗抑鬱藥。程凱攙扶不適的定垚，巧遇澤雨及明晞，澤雨以為二人拍拖。啟堂想將十二生肖像擺放在會議室，獨欠的龍像由高哲投得，高哲卻在他面前把龍像打破，啟堂氣極。啟堂誣衊定垚有精神病，父女決裂。定垚重新與高哲合作發展能源項目，惹程凱不滿。明晞得知天生早有離婚安排感痛心，繼而受思琪的氣更氣憤，幸得澤雨為她出頭。

programme.desc: 有僱主與外傭終止合約後，陸續收到兩間財務公司的追債信，懷疑外傭趁政府新規例生效前借款並離職，試圖逃避債務。女網友經網上遊戲結識一名自稱泰拳冠軍的男子，並發展親密關係後意外懷孕，繼而在男方安排下墮胎。事後渣男母親卻指墮胎影響其子運程，多次情緒勒索女事主。女事主借錢幫男方還債後，竟發現男方屢次出軌……香港小姐候選佳麗會晤大會評判及最上鏡小姐評判，伍允龍、謝天華透露評分標準。另介紹有關管理強積金的資訊。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 睡眠窒息症是一種常見睡眠障礙，患者睡覺時會因上呼吸道變窄，而導致反覆出現窒息或半窒息，增加罹患高血壓、糖尿病等疾病風險。家庭醫學專科醫生詳析睡眠窒息症的三大類別，並細說如何透過睡眠測試評估病情，並帶來治療資訊。遺囑與持久授權書是最常需要醫生評估並親自見證的法律文件，律師講解二者分別，以及訂立時的注意事項。腦神經外科醫生則述說為患者做評估的相關細節。「睇餸食飯」，許美德師傅示範「潮州蠔烙拼炸銀魚」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 斧頭扒深受肉食者喜愛，往深圳叫一個雙人餐，斧頭扒盡情撕吃兼副食放題！三人同行的話，加選鵝肝牛小排，CP值亦高。珠海某間在水中央的玻璃屋小店，日系風情配上充滿禪意的「藝術甜品」，秀怡還預約好幾款隱藏甜點，驚喜連連。香港有間百年老字號餐廳，在商場開設年輕版分店，菜式將傳統與新派融合，濃味之餘亦喚出兩代人的溫情與幸福感；再到另一個商場的日式食肆享用廚師發辦，海膽、豆腐、蟹膏同時放進嘴裡，口感有多豐富？

programme.title: 天梯#2粵
programme.desc: 美娟要新月接手當家之職，但她拒絕，美娟懷疑自己時日無多。廣達發現賀正堂大查櫃賀坤堯從中食價，最終無法把藥材賣出，苗天只好硬著頭皮求賀正堂，豈料二查櫃，即坤堯的兒子世豪肆意侮辱，鄭嬌忍無可忍出手打世豪。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#171粵
programme.desc: 舊同學阿融要邀請花出席舊生聚會。義卻看中花的舊同學群，應有不少富家子弟，正是他推銷保險的最佳時機，於是自薦成為花的舞伴。眾人大表贊成，眾女士更越俎代庖，為花準備舞會的「戰衣」，根本沒有理會花的感覺。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#16粵普
programme.desc: 郭靖和黃蓉利用竹排挪開巨石，歐陽鋒救出歐陽克。之後歐陽鋒以洪七公要脅郭靖默寫九陰真經，又要求他砍樹造船。黃蓉和郭靖帶著洪七公乘木筏離開，途中遇上風浪，三人看到前方有大船便呼救，怎料竟遇上完顏洪烈等人。

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 黃凱芹從加拿大遠道而來，深情演繹經典情歌，並與二胡名家王憓中西樂cross over、請結他高手蘇德華「jam」一首<忘盡心中情。他還演唱「四大天王」經典金曲、與秋官及Liza姐合唱歌曲。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#172粵
programme.desc: 義發現三妗婆強拉花與別人「相睇」，相親對象是「頭油阿叔」阿華。義在家中說出此事，令眾人擔心花的終生幸福。喜到廟內拜神時，得悉花並非三妗婆的親生女兒；眾人都擔心這名養母會出賣「女兒」的終生幸福。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#17粵普PG
programme.desc: 歐陽鋒懷疑郭靖給的是假的《九陰真經》，黃蓉聲稱能替他翻譯，要求一餐換翻譯一頁經文；周伯通突然空降船上救走黃蓉等人後就來到牛家村，在酒館內發現傻姑，而傻姑竟然會桃花島的武功，而後在密室發現曲靈風的屍骨…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽用水果入饌出神入化，由教切大樹菠蘿講起，用豬尾骨、蜜棗、陳皮烹調「大樹菠蘿湯」；又買來紅毛榴槤炮製雪糕。她以韓式調味料開芡煮牛肋條，事前選用雪梨蓉來醃，有何功用？還有一道用木煙熏的「豉油王熏雞」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 眼睛是敏感及相對脆弱的器官，如有血漿、脂質或蛋白質等液體從血管滲漏，並積聚在視網膜下方，或會導致「滲出性視網膜炎」，如何檢測？治療方面，眼科醫生建議先觀察，再考慮修補漏血管及消除積水。適量的中高強度運動有助柏金遜症患者改善平衡力，以至延緩病情。相關團體還成立乒乓球隊，讓「柏友」藉此提高手眼協調性及反應能力。團體代表偕隊長同來，分享得着及深刻點滴。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨示範「意式白酒水瓜子燴雞」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 來到網紅追捧的珠海文化區，享用擺盤精緻的花花主題套餐，閨密們打卡慶生好去處！深圳熱賣椰子雞火鍋，鮮味雞件與清甜椰青湯底可謂絕配；臘味煲仔飯也是暖胃之選。超市有售雪藏貓山王果肉、榴槤薄餅，榴槤控為你「試伏」。回港搜羅「吃貨」優惠情報，日式居酒屋的蟹宴二人餐可嚐盡松葉蟹、皇帝蟹、鱈場蟹滋味，甲羅燒釜飯更是啖啖蟹膏，勁滿足！鬧市中隱藏「森系玻璃屋」，特色套餐匯聚十道亞洲風味，讓人在田園氛圍下忙裡偷閒。

programme.title: 天梯#3粵
programme.desc: 鄭嬌因出手打世豪被捕，世豪傷勢惡化，鄭嬌再次被扣留，苗天成功要脅坤堯放過鄭嬌。世章欲揭發坤堯所做不法之事，卻被坤堯輕易脫身，坤堯反指世章不尊重他，聲言要請假十天。苗天與鄭嬌發現所有藥材均發霉。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 時下流行穿熱褲，丸尾媽媽其實一直嚮往穿熱褲，但在家中試穿時卻被丸尾看到，後者大感震驚。爺爺打算丟掉沒用的舊物，小丸子助他分類後，爺爺卻表示不捨得丟，嫲嫲指出舊物是打開記憶的鎖匙。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 兒童體適能教練主理「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，小朋友準備好了嗎？雙腳踏穩，用手指做訓練。左手「L」字，右手「1」字，雙手不停互換；試試做「雙V」手勢並併合成「W」字，再分開雙手做出「L」字，可考驗協調度與全身肌力。再進一步，連雙腳都要跟着指令做！運用膠紙在地上貼一條直線，沿着線向前行之餘，再先後做出「開合跳」、「側身踏步」、「交叉跳」、「跳躍後蹲下」的動作，是一套講求心肺及協調能力的鍛練。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 花騎士・真誠的出現，令公主意識到愛麗絲比亞有新的敵人。到底新敵人是何方神聖？懷著什麼目的？公主們都百思不得其解。適逢今天是奈津的演唱會，這個大家等待已久的盛事，終究也避不過敵人的魔爪。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
programme.desc: 香港人頭腦靈活，經常有創新意念，事實上香港有很多不出名的發明，亦有很多不出名的發明家，當中有幾多會成功呢？新聞掏寶和大家重溫2004年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 東張西望粵 及 2026香港小姐 敢．至完美粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#14粵
programme.desc: 嘉冰認出電視台歌唱比賽「當年好聲音」上屆冠軍原是其手下敗將，她當年曾勝出業餘歌唱比賽，因父親反對未能投身歌壇。另一方面，萬里不滿嘉冰蠶食其生活，再度設法逼她離開。萬里的舊客戴志昌轉投楊帆旗下，贊助新一屆「當年好聲音」，打算安排冠軍唱出其廣告歌，卻不滿楊帆提交的歌曲。萬里獲安排協助宣傳，伺機奪回志昌這位大客……萬里設法誘嘉冰返回加拿大，卻觸及其傷心事，令她負氣離去。最終，嘉冰回來宣佈一個驚人決定……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#19粵
programme.desc: 曉彤成功使啟榮批准家謙加入渡假村小組。幸如等人與浩恩拍攝家電廣告，熙妍看着浩恩、幸如互動感不是味兒。熙妍得知幸如、浩恩被惡霸擄走，焦急帶人營救……啟榮、哲朗忌憚曉彤、家謙聯盟，哲朗吩咐助手Edmond找出曉彤的黑材料。繼威等人籌備新廣告，繼威被青春模特兒Emma吸引，雪文妒忌。雪文與佩貞的婆媳糾紛愈演愈烈，繼威煩惱不已。這時繼威與Emma不期而遇，似乎對上了眼……

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#24粵普
programme.desc: 蜜語調職到銷售部後，沒有發揮機會；寄舟畫展在香港洽談期間出現問題，蜜語趁機遊說他在浦榮舉辦，紀封由反對到支持舉辦畫展；錢迅趁機想要除去紀封；一切本來安排得非常妥當，展出前蜜語發現最重要的主展品不見了…

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Slim益生菌呈獻：南美潮什麼2粵
programme.desc: 來到哥國卡塔赫納附近小鎮，不可錯過托圖莫火山泥漿浴，還有專人按摩服務，好歎！被納入世遺的卡塔赫納舊城區，保留了殖民時期建築與城牆古蹟，舊式住宅大門還裝有不同動物門環，象徵甚麼意思？小社區搖身一變藝術蒲點，街頭壁畫隨處可見，打卡一流！遊沿海城市必嚐鮮，先試平民熱捧炸魚，再吃醃魚料理、海鮮燴飯。芷珮也慕名到咖啡店，品味冠軍級咖啡，有手信可將咖啡搽上身？登上「海盜船」出海吹風，在夕陽映照下享受悠閒時光！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
再創世紀#32粵PG
programme.desc: 明晞與澤雨到德國公幹，澤雨提議明晞放假，並帶她遊覽布拉格。澤雨在歌劇院門外巧遇定垚，二人重拾當日感覺，相約同遊時，卻被明晞暗中破壞。天生保釋回家，高哲預感天生及啟堂會有所動作，果然對方比他們早一步召開超級電池記者會，並命名為「烏托邦計劃」，程凱氣憤指責二人偷去他的設計概念。明晞被蒙在鼓裡，對天生失望。天生感到明晞與澤雨有曖昧，夫妻攤牌。天生邀請天蔭加入烏托邦計劃，澤雨拒絕，天生的一番話卻令他動搖。

programme.desc: 歐陽鋒懷疑郭靖給的是假的《九陰真經》，黃蓉聲稱能替他翻譯，要求一餐換翻譯一頁經文；周伯通突然空降船上救走黃蓉等人後就來到牛家村，在酒館內發現傻姑，而傻姑竟然會桃花島的武功，而後在密室發現曲靈風的屍骨…

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 「巨聲幫」林欣彤、陳慧敏決戰「兄弟幫」范振鋒、林盛斌。在波爾多，馬球有新玩法，猜猜會以甚麼取代馬匹？Do姐大方讓眾人提問，卻被阿范氣得呼其「鋒哥」，究竟發生何事？鄺潔楹帶大家參觀東京特色酒店，房內的蛋形物件大有用途！去旅行，當然要認識當地文化，法國人喝酒時有指定動作，關乎會否「行衰運」！兩位兄弟在答題板以「Jump」代「斟」，搞乜東東？兌換環節，慧敏賽前曾得方力申提供「貼士」，可會信錯人？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 黃翠如與陸浩明（6號）接受Do姐的問題大考驗，6號於看片前還拿「肥媽」來創作口號，現場反應卻不似預期。韓國的濟州盛產綠茶，在火山爆發形成的洞穴咖啡店內，還有特別的綠茶體驗？曼谷的非一般停車位，有何條件方能使用？周星馳的電影告訴大家，不可單憑外表判斷物品的用途。「問題專員」鄺潔楹在東京找來幾可亂真的「煙肉露筍卷」，其「真身」是……有嘉賓的二千積分最終價值不足一港元，到底兌換期間發生了甚麼事？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

programme.desc: 花潛入義房，找出舞會當天所穿舞衣，懷念二人共舞。花驚見同事Betty與藥房員工墮入愛河，更得知是女方主動追求，因此啟發了花。可是花到高家吃飯時，得知義心藏「夢中女神」程家敏的消息，使花打消向有義示愛。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌 之 森田面膜咁敷至完美粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 林子博、容羨媛帶同子女到訪，菜式以老少咸宜為主。香蕉朱古力西多、酥皮肉卷均迎合小朋友口味，而一道「冬菇冬筍燜乳鴿」竟令兩歲小女孩食到筍不離手？還有補肺的金銀菜煲豬肺湯、原隻八寶芝士蒸南瓜和豬頸肉雞煲。

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 學者指黑眼圈可分為四大類型，並詳述有關特徵與改善建議。除了睡眠不足外，嘉賓也提到鼻敏感、經常揉眼睛等都有機會導致黑眼圈。長者退休後需面對生活轉變，容易影響心理健康。心理治療師提醒老友記要接納身體機能退化為自然生理現象，並多與親友溝通，保持樂觀心態。跟家人和睦相處有技巧，他強調互相體諒是關鍵，亦鼓勵長者積極學習新事物、培養興趣，以正面態度迎接人生下半場。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅示範「柚子醬鴨」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 由深圳灣口岸過關，在前海寶安區摩天輪附近打卡後，是時候飲杯茶、吃個甜點唞一唞，何解喝杯玫瑰茶卻似飲啤酒？轉往珠海，坐三分鐘纜車上石景山飽覽完風景，下山竟不用兩分鐘？原來是坐車沿滑道快速落山，超怡略嫌未夠喉！主持在珠海還一試高質實力派粵菜，以及酒店按摩。香港的吃貨優惠未夠貼地？這集有茶餐廳小菜套餐推介，縱是茶記卻可吃到菜膽雞與避風塘炒蝦？同枱附送招牌酥皮蛋撻！另到銅鑼灣品嚐鐵板燒餐廳的隱藏餐單。

programme.title: 天梯#4粵
programme.desc: 世章提出只要苗天寫一個「欠」字，便即付三千元給他們。苗天向村民派發利錢，發現田愛娣的姑娘在拜祭父母。苗天陪鄭嬌拜祭亡妻，遇鍾鑑帶愛娣看墳地，更替她要求減價。愛娣下車後發現世章等她，還送了她珍珠項鏈。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 學校檢查學生有否剪指甲，小丸子等人忘了剪，丸尾恐嚇他們晚上剪指甲會見不到父母最後一面。某家人種的繡球花開得很美，媽媽說花是粉紅色，爸爸卻說是水藍色，媽媽聽後不知何故有點慍怒。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 大家有沒有想過擁有一個專屬的夢幻城堡？這次「Artspiration」，子健哥哥會指導各位如何利用簡單的紙和筆，一步步畫出心目中的魔幻城堡。隨後，他與玲玲姐姐還會為各自的城堡塗上顏色，讓作品變得更色彩繽紛。隨着暑假踏入尾聲，本集「開心SHARE」邀請小朋友投稿分享「放假我最喜歡去的地方」。有孩子喜歡於假期時跟家人到沙灘嬉戲，這也勾起了Tiffany姐姐兒時與家人，在沙灘埋下時光錦囊的溫馨回憶。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 正當阿燎準備還書，大家都說想見識一下愛麗絲比亞的中央圖書館，於是與阿燎一同前往。在圖書館，大家偶遇風花堇師姐，原來她會定期來到圖書館，為愛麗絲族講故事。可是在閒談之間，阿堇竟露出不悅之色。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌 之 森田面膜咁敷至完美粵
programme.desc: 長沙灣一房不足250平方呎，但樓底夠高，設計師利用拼色突出北歐田園主題，效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 2026香港小姐 敢．至完美粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#15粵
programme.desc: 嘉冰決定參加「當年好聲音」，並與萬里打賭，若成功通過海選，萬里便不可再逼她離開。因戴志昌贊助節目，萬里等人參與籌辦海選工作；楊帆則忙於籌備廣告歌，分身乏術。萬里特意安排三名友人與嘉冰同組參賽，希望阻止她入選。另一邊廂，嘉冰為爭一口氣而積極備戰，吃盡苦頭……海選當天，擔任評判的楊帆得知萬里有親人參賽，揚言決不放水。萬里察覺嘉冰似有不妥，更無意中得知她回港的真正原因。臨出場前，嘉冰竟萌生退意……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#20粵PG
programme.desc: 幸如等人勸婉蘭與丈夫分開，但婉蘭繼續自欺欺人。幸如、熙妍發現幸如夢中經歷的不幸似乎出現在婉蘭等人身上……啟榮的太太林舒雅娘家雅爾頓集團財困，啟榮表面順從苓君的注資決定，卻密謀於雅爾頓取得權力。雪文發現繼威與Emma密會，報復女方導致其受傷；東窗事發，雪文面臨被解僱危機……家謙、幸如向啟榮匯報，啟榮異常浮躁地批評匯報內容。佩貞與雪文的生母沈淑冰爭吵，混亂間雪文誤傷佩貞，終引致雪文與繼威、佩貞鬧僵。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#25粵普
programme.desc: 寄舟的畫不翼而飛，蜜語想到用其他畫代替便匆忙去拿。獲貞貞准許參與開幕禮的記者對寄舟處處挑釁，然而蜜語一直未將畫送回酒店；原來一切都在紀封掌握之中…事後蜜語覺得不被紀封信任而提分手，並去新西蘭洽談生意。

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Slim益生菌呈獻：南美潮什麼2粵
programme.desc: 坐兩小時快艇縱橫加勒比海，住進一間浮水旅館，入覺時也可感受加勒比海的海風！旅館面積小，不妨參加遊覽團，前往附近的小島逛一逛，包括全世界人口密度最高的人工島聖克魯斯島，游水、徒手捉魚也可輕鬆玩樂一番。到訪全美洲規模最大的鳥類保育園，近距離觀賞紅鸛、鸚鵡，更有孔雀在芷珮面前開屏呢！旅程最後一站到達哥國的黑人城鎮帕淪克，鎮民娶妻要「打得」？而當地女士擅長煮食，芷珮一嚐住家炮製的椰子糖，大讚好味！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌 之 森田面膜咁敷至完美粵
再創世紀#33粵PG
programme.desc: 澤雨告知程凱與小慧，天蔭將加入烏托邦計劃，二人感到被背叛。永廉查得烏托邦只是個泡沫，定垚想天蔭懸崖勒馬，可惜澤雨只想重振方家。有消息指烏托邦的實驗室造假，π宇宙停牌，天生及啟堂回應屈奇頓亦有意加入，令股價不跌反升，啟堂情緒高漲而心臟病發，天生冷眼旁觀。定垚對父親的死無能為力，頹廢度日，幸有澤雨守護在旁。依寧把大公司有意收購屈奇頓的消息告知敬賢，敬賢卻不感興趣，事後依寧將消息告訴投行經理，二人決裂。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 康有為、梁啟超提出戊戌變法，要學生讀通識，農夫學耕田？慈禧請來義和團對付八國聯軍，最終被火燒圓明園，王晶、游清源計算她一生的成與敗。古代靈異事件研究所所長翻查古書，借助現代高科技揭開古代靈異事件之謎！

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 中國古代有四大美人，黎芷珊訪問羞花美人楊貴妃。當年已為人妻的她為何會被老爺搶去？被唐玄宗趕出宮後，她如何憑一頭秀髮重返宮中？人稱關二哥的關羽為何得到黑白二道崇拜？綠帽、紅面、大關刀的形象又由誰人設計？

programme.title: 奇怪妙妙屋S2

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產(完)
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 陷入純情(完)
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 陷入純情(完)
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 不像三兄弟(完)
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Submarino
programme.desc: Accidentalmente, Chip y sus amigos caen a un lago donde son recogidos por la nave espacial de un átomo de sodio, que los lleva a Sodia, una ciudad submarina. Allí, los átomos de sodio y cloro viven un largo conflicto. El cloro quiere unirse al sodio para formar moléculas de cloruro de sodio, mientras que los átomos de sodio prefieren permanecer juntos. La patrulla de antimateria entra en contacto con el cloro y les propone proporcionarles rifles para dominar al sodio y así obligarlos a molecularizarse, pero Chip se burla de la antimateria y logra que el cloro y el sodio dejen de ser enemigos, restableciendo la paz en el mundo submarino.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La tormenta
programme.desc: Dentro de un viejo molino de viento, en medio de una fuerte tormenta, Chip y sus amigos esperan que pase y continúan su camino. Afuera, bajo el viento tempestuoso, la patrulla de antimateria le comunica al Dr. No que ya han encontrado al niño. El malvado científico confía en que esta vez no fallarán. Pero cuando el viento amaina, Chip idea una estrategia y deja a la antimateria encerrada en el molino, mientras él y los átomos siguen adelante.

programme.desc: God’s Gang faces insane challenges - from stopping a mad scientist to battling aliens and saving blue whales.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyson the Tanker refuels Jeremy
programme.desc: Oh no, Jeremy ran out of gas! Troy selects the most perfect truck to refuel him: Tyson the Tanker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Francis the Forklift helps at the construction site
programme.desc: Edgar made a mess at the construction site! Troy selects the best truck to help with the clean-up: Francis the Forklift!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyler the Tyke steals candy
programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her master's family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case…

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after a Qing army attack, but suffers serious injuries while fleeing. Mistaking Hong for a dangerous outlaw, Fang captures him and hands him over to the Qing soldiers. After learning the truth, Fang does everything he can to rescue Hong, so the two can join forces against the Qing army.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people by siding with the Qing and recruiting fighters from all backgrounds. Members of the Wudang and Emei sects are among the first to surrender and collude with local bullies. When they attack the Shaolin Monastery, its renowned disciples must unite to fight their enemies.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness &amp; innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancée enlists a swordsman—who secretly loves her—to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the “Full Moon Scimitar”, on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society’s conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the other’s mole.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom. Later, Ying discovers that she is pregnant but no one can remember

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: God of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: After the God of Gamblers Ko Chun disappears, his disciple Little Knife rises in the gambling world. His fame attracts a ruthless rival who seeks to defeat him. Facing high-stakes games, Little Knife must rely on his skills to overcome his enemies and defend the honour of the God of Gamblers.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - A Glorious End, Part One
programme.desc: Armed with the power of Gaylen's Core, Morando's forces attack Arcadia as the Royals fight to protect their lives and their adopted Earth home.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - A Glorious End, Part Two
programme.desc: In the final battle against Morando, Aja and Krel must make an unexpected sacrifice to win the day to save their Akiridion and Earthen homes.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Terra Incognita Part One
programme.desc: The evil General Morando launches a coup on the alien planet Akiridion-5. They seek refuge on a backwater planet: Earth.

programme.title: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Battle Royal
programme.desc: Morgana takes a new title — Mother of Monsters — and vows to usher in an age of reckoning. An epic battle begins in King Arthur's court.

programme.title: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Killahead, Part One
programme.desc: Arthur seeks an alliance with the trolls of Dwoza as Gunmar begins building his army. Merlin and Douxie join forces to forge the amulet.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Not My Boy Brandon Shady Shawn
programme.desc: Tip and Oh get an annoying "tagalong" friend who won't leave them aloneThe Tucci's go camping with Lucy's new boyfriend

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - B.R.A.P. It's A Booviful Life
programme.desc: Oh is stuck in an alternate universe; Oh's new ranking as most respected Boov Rapper in Chicago is threatened

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Dang, I'm Rich! Power Play
programme.desc: Cousin Ashley sets out to strike it rich and buy himself a mansion. Archibald explores Crackridge during a blackout with a new pal.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Big Fun Town New Crackridge
programme.desc: Archibald and Bea plan another couple's long overdue honeymoon. Is a tornado coming to Crackridge? Archibald sure seems to think so.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Plays The Piano
programme.desc: Olivia sees herself as a great concert pianist, though her piano teacher thinks she needs a little more practice. But when her little brother Ian begins taking his own piano lessons – and turns out to be pretty good – Olivia isn't sure if there's room for two prodigies in the family.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Plays Football
programme.desc: Francine is chosen to play goalie, and Olivia is disappointed that she doesn't get to wear the red goalie jersey. Even worse, the uniform she designs for herself only causes chaos and confusion among her teammates. But when Francine is better at dodging the ball than stopping it, it's up to Olivia to put on the red goalie jersey and save the day

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Trains Her Cat
programme.desc: When Olivia's class holds a pet talent show, nobody can beat Francine's amazingly talented cat Gwendolyn. Olivia's lethargic cat Edwin, who barely moves, suddenly goes missing. Olivia then fancies herself a cat detective as shetracks down the missing cat.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia's Lemonade Stand
programme.desc: Olivia's lemonade stand is losing customers to Francine's pink lemonade stand. Olivia does her one better by opening up her own full-scale backyard restaurant, imagining it's a fabulous supper club. But Olivia soon finds that her restaurant needs something she can only get from Francine – something pink!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Store Day
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a coin purse with kitty coins, it's Store Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy help out at all the different stores (Cakey's Bakery, Baby Box's Craft Emporium, Kitty Fairy's Flower Shoppe) to earn kitty coins and save up for a melodicat at the Grand Opening of DJ Catnip’s Music Store!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Cleat without Feet Real Magic
programme.desc: When Phoebe accidentally knocks Harper's soccer cleat off the balcony before the big game, the Dew Drops must venture into the city to retrieve the cleat. When Dylan starts practicing magic tricks, Athena thinks his magic is real! But when the Dew Drops investigate his “magic hat,” they accidentally break it and must fix it before Dylan’s magic show for the neighborhood kids.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Sleepover Save The Very Hungry Vacuum
programme.desc: Marcus is having his first sleepover and Phoebe is concerned that Marcus may be nervous so Phoebe sets out to make sure he has the best first sleepover ever. When Athena’s magical jump rope gets sucked up by the family’s new robot vacuum, she loses confidence in her abilities, only to learn that her real abilities are already inside her.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Rangers
programme.desc: Kitty Ranger Team Leader Mama Box helps Kitty Ranger Gabby and Pandy get a lost Baby Me-Owl back home to its Mama in the Fairy Tale Garden. They embark on a hiking adventure! They learn about animal tracking, earn patches along the way, and ultimately, reunite Baby with Mama!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Meow-Mazing Games
programme.desc: When Gabby, Pandy, and Carlita prepare for the annual Meow-Mazing Games, they encounter stiff competition from the Doodads and must work together to bring home the coveted dollhouse trophy.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Hermit Fab
programme.desc: When Gloria meets a shy hermit crab, named Starlene, with a secret talent of tap dancing, Gloria plans a flashy production for Starlene’s debut so she can share her talent with the world! But Gloria doesn’t ask Starlene what she wants, and pushes the crab’s introverted self too far, ultimately learning you have to respect your shy friends' comfort levels they may be different than yours.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - The Bear Necessities
programme.desc: When their favorite zoo visitor loses his teddy bear, our gang goes on a wild adventure through New York City to return it to him - and in the process Marty learns that some things in life can't be found in an instruction manual.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Stuff Campout
programme.desc: When Kelp and Scallop discover Mr. Pearly has a cave full of stuff they help him to realize it could help a lot of other sea creatures. When the group goes camping, Kelp helps Ollie learn that even though it didn’t go exactly as planned, they can still have loads of fun.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Family Trip Great Great Grandicorn
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop help Dad discover the true meaning of family trips. When the Great Great Grandicorn comes to visit, the kids learn that making mistakes is part of learning.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Welcome to Pawston \ Ruff Day on the Job
programme.desc: Tag wants to bring her new neighbor, Scooch, to the Party in the Tree. But a series of traffic jams make Tag impatient, and she keeps trying to find different ways to get to the party. Thanks to Tag’s handiness - and one of Lady Lydia’s hats - they make it to the party just in time. \ Pawston’s new canine mail carrier keeps getting chased by dogs, so Tag and Scooch have to help him deliver the mail.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Dark Park Bark Lark \ The Fast and the Curious
programme.desc: Tag and Scooch team up to get all of Scooch's chores done in time for the Barkapellas Bark In the Park In the Dark concert. \ Tag is so excited to join the Sam Whippet’s Race Cadets. But when Tag and Scooch show up at the racetrack, there’s lots of competition. And to complete the first challenge - a pedal car race - they’re going to have to work together.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Tanaka's Moving Castle Zenko Don't Go
programme.desc: Mr. Tanaka is moving places all by himself, so Team Zenko step in to assist, and learn the importance of asking people for help. When Sam's skateboard competition falls on the same day as her favourite creator Ken KaBlam's comic book signing, TZG secretly prevents him leaving town before she gets the chance to meet him.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Driven to Distraction To Bee or Not To Bee
programme.desc: When easily-distracted Luis is tasked with getting flowers for his grandmother's birthday party, TZG secretly keeps him on track. When Rodney's honey bees escape from their apiary (artificial beehive), TZG secretly brings them back.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Belly Flop
programme.desc: The Riders have to save Elbone when he's swallowed by a giant Sea Gronckle, and Dak's awful cooking might be just the thing to do it.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Game of Horns
programme.desc: At a big town festival, Magnus challenges Duggard in a competition to be chief of Huttsgalor! Can the Riders help their friend keep his helmet?

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Rainy Day Banana
programme.desc: With a little help from Gabby’s imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - CatRat The Bandit
programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S1 - Mr. Ladybug's SecretWetyard
programme.desc: When Rabbit blackmails Mr. Ladybug into doing one last job for him, Berry wants in on the action. The backyard gets flooded, so Rocksy forms a crew out of the Mighty Ones and search for dry land.

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S1 - BumbleberryLeaf's Still Cool
programme.desc: Rocksy discovers that Verry Berry is fascinated with bees, but when Berry innocently cosplays as a bee, she disappears into the hive and doesn't emerge. After reuniting with an old friend, Leaf goes to great, unsafe lengths to prove that he's still a cool daredevil.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S2 - Bootless Cries
programme.desc: After Puss decides everything bad happening in town is his fault and pursues a new career, the Mole King invades San Lorenzo and changes everything

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S2 - Sullen Earth
programme.desc: When the Mole King kidnaps Uli, Puss realizes that confidence alone isn't always enough ammunition to defeat a powerful army

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Christmas Spirit
programme.desc: When Miradero's Christmas presents are delayed and snow isn't falling, Lucky and her friends decide it's up to them to bring the Christmas spirit to Miradero.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Deadly Blizzard
programme.desc: When a sudden blizzard hits Miradero, Lucky and Maricela must work together to save the town.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - Grandpa's Treasures
programme.desc: In the wake of her grandfather's death, Lucky sets out to show the town his softer side and give him the goodbye he deserves.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - There Will Be Mud
programme.desc: Big Oil is bringing big improvements to the school. But new track stables, an upgraded veterinary lab and dorm rooms come at a cost — and spark disaster.

programme.desc: Eager to get the campers out of his hair, Krupp orders them to climb Plummet Peak, where a terrifying creature is rumored to reside.

programme.desc: Harold and George don't ask for much -- just a fun scavenger hunt that doesn't include doing Krupp's errands. Careful what you wish for, fellas.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Monstrous Mayhem of the Massive Melviathan
programme.desc: A run-of-the-mill arts and crafts session turns into an interdimensional adventure from which Harold, George and company may never return.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Eye Of The Beholder Pt 2
programme.desc: Hiccup, Toothless and the Dragon Riders journey to Glacier Island in search of the Snow Wraith, a fearsome dragon that holds key to the Dragon Eye's mysteries.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Imperfect Harmony
programme.desc: The Dragon Riders discover a lush island that turns out to be the home of the Deathsong, a massive dragon that threatens to trap them forever.
